message.content:
Based on my search, here's information about Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools:

## Welch Allyn Ophthalmology Tools Overview

Welch Allyn (now part of Hillrom) is a leading manufacturer of diagnostic ophthalmic instruments, specializing in ophthalmoscopes and comprehensive diagnostic sets for eye examinations.

### Main Ophthalmoscope Models

**1. PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope (Top-of-the-Line)**
- **Field of view**: 25 degrees — **20 times larger** than standard coaxial ophthalmoscopes
- **Quick Eye alignment technology** — helps direct patient gaze for better optic disc alignment
- **DuraShock technology** — impact-resistant design for enhanced durability
- **Digital image capture capability** — for documentation and monitoring
- **LED illumination** — long-lasting, no frequent lamp replacements needed
- **5-year warranty**
- Features disc-alignment lights and a polarized light beam for easier entry into undilated pupils
- Provides 5x larger view of the fundus in an undilated eye compared to standard ophthalmoscopes

**2. Basic PanOptic Ophthalmoscope**
- Same **20x larger field of view** as the Plus model
- **DuraShock technology** included
- LED illumination
- **1-year warranty**
- No digital image capture capability
- No cobalt blue filter for corneal examination

**3. Traditional/Standard Coaxial Ophthalmoscope**
- Standard field of view (5 degrees)
- Coaxial optics produce shadow-free spot and easier entry into undilated pupils
- **28 focusing lenses** with range of -25 to +40 diopters
- **18 aperture/filter combinations**
- Halogen HPX® lamp (with LED upgrade available)
- Features include: micro-spot aperture, cobalt blue filter, red-free filter, polarizing filter
- **1-year warranty**
- More economical option

**4. PocketScope Ophthalmoscope (Portable)**
- Lightweight, compact 2.5V design
- **48 focusing lenses**
- 12 aperture/filter combinations
- Halogen illumination
- Powered by "AA" batteries
- Ideal for mobile or fast-paced environments

**5. Pocket Junior Ophthalmoscope**
- Ultra-lightweight and compact
- 6 aperture selections
- Sealed optics to keep out dust
- Includes red-free and cobalt blue filters
- Uses standard "AA" batteries

### Diagnostic Sets

Welch Allyn offers various diagnostic set configurations that typically include:

| Model | Ophthalmoscope | Otoscope | Power Handle | Best For |
|-------|---------------|----------|--------------|----------|
| 71PM3LXE-US | PanOptic Plus LED | MacroView Plus LED | Premium Li-Ion USB | Advanced, high-end exams |
| 71PM2LXU-US | PanOptic Basic LED | MacroView Basic LED | Li-Ion Plus | Everyday use with LED |
| 71SM2LXU | Coaxial | MacroView Basic LED | Li-Ion | Mid-range performance |
| 71SM2CXX | Coaxial | MacroView Basic LED | NiCad | Budget-conscious practices |
| 71SS2CXX | Standard | Standard | NiCad | Entry-level/basic needs |

### Key Accessories & Features

- **Power handles**: Available in Lithium-Ion (longer run time, lighter weight) or Nickel-Cadmium (more economical)
- **LED upgrade kits** available for older halogen models
- **iExaminer Pro App** compatibility for digital image capture and sharing
- **767 Integrated Wall Systems** — wall-mounted diagnostic stations combining ophthalmoscope, otoscope, aneroid, and optional thermometer

### Retinoscopes

Welch Allyn also produces the **Elite Retinoscope** for refraction procedures:
- 2.8x brighter than standard retinoscopes
- Superior streak quality for easier, quicker refractions
- Crossed linear polarizing filter eliminates glare
- Converts from streak to spot retinoscope by changing the lamp

---

Sources:
1. https://cornellsurgical.com/blogs/default-blog/diagnostic-sets-full-comparison-guide?srsltid=AfmBOoo4mJTylX-gl2NUkWpvAANAodyPMHR19BSdX49ibOtoN8Nz_GUQ
2. https://www.dispomed.com/welch-allyn-ophthalmoscope-purchase-guide/
3. https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/
4. https://www.medteq.gr/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/Welch-Allyn-Product-Catalogue.pdf
5. https://www.techsciresearch.com/blog/product-review-new-welch-allyn-panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope-and-welch-allyn-macroview-plus-otoscope/213.html
